function.name: ch_get_act_article
function.description: Text of one article of a Swiss federal act (Fedlex) as consolidated on a date. Returns the edition whose validity interval covers as_of; without as_of, the edition in force today. Response: {sr_number, abbreviation, title, lang, as_of, version{version_id, date_applicability, date_end_applicability, eli_consolidation_uri}, article{e_id, article_number, marginal_note, text}} or {error: 'no_edition_for_date' | 'article_not_found'}.

sr_number.description: SR number of the act, e.g. '220'

as_of.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the edition must be in force on; default: today

function.name: ch_get_act_history
function.description: Edition history of a Swiss federal act: every consolidated edition with its validity interval, and the per-article changes between consecutive editions (optionally filtered to one article).

sr_number.description: SR number of the act, e.g. '220'

article.description: Article number to filter the change list to, e.g. '336a'

function.name: ch_get_act_text
function.description: Full text of a Swiss federal act in the edition in force on a date, paged by character offset.

sr_number.description: SR number of the act, e.g. '220'

as_of.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the edition must be in force on
